title: Design: the price details' matrix line and Same as previous tier row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, made right after tier A, on Same as previous tier in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier B for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with part A added.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at part A's sell price on the Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Matrix row reads matrix A's name, " · " and tier A's name, with no Work Order Matrix side named.
  • A row labelled "Same as previous tier" reads tier A's name, as in picture 12.2.
